state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 6 (typed values) in progress: the flag readers are done, and `with`, the ranged merge, the schema and `int`/`bool` are open.** Stages 1 to 5 are done, and Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Filter`, `Ldap\Dn`, `Ldap\Ad`, `Ldap\Sid`, and `Entry`'s typed readers `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant`, `duration`, `accountFlags`, `groupType`, `accountType`. `Ad\AccountFlags` and `Ad\GroupType` have one `bool` reader per flag and `bits()`; `Ad\AccountType` is an enum. The flag tables are `crates/nvs-ldap/src/value.rs` (`ACCOUNT_FLAGS`, `GROUP_TYPE_FLAGS`), the bodies `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/flags.rs`. The readers are methods, not properties, because a `Core` instance has no property (`flags.rs`' module doc). `search` and `read` add `msDS-User-Account-Control-Computed` when `userAccountControl` is selected. `with({...})` and `mustChangePassword` are not written yet. `instant` picks FILETIME or GeneralizedTime by the value's form, not yet by the schema. `Entry::int` and `Entry::bool` are not written yet.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`. `CN=Users` holds exactly three users: `Administrator` (`userAccountControl` 512), `Guest` (66082) and `krbtgt`. Guest and krbtgt are disabled. `Domain Admins` is `groupType` -2147483646 and `CN=Administrators,CN=Builtin` is -2147483643. GUIDs, SIDs and times change each time the container is made, so a case asserts their shape, never the value.

items.text: **`with({...})` on `Ad\AccountFlags` and `Ad\GroupType`, and `AccountFlags::mustChangePassword`** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`, ADR 0278 §§ 1 and 8). `with` takes one `?bool` option per settable flag (not `lockedOut` or `passwordExpired`), sets or clears only those bits, and keeps every other bit. No `Core` options bag has a `?bool` option with a `null` default yet, so check `CoreOption` first. Readers are `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/flags.rs:58`, rows after `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:1580`. `mustChangePassword` needs `pwdLastSet = 0`, so `search` would also request `pwdLastSet` beside the computed attribute (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:104`).

**Ranged attribute merge and the schema read once per pool** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`, ADR 0278 § 8). The search loop is `nvs_core_ldap_entries_advance` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:1`; tests `a_ranged_member_list_is_merged_to_its_end` and `the_schema_is_read_once_per_pool` after `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:826`.
**`Entry::int` and `Entry::bool`** (ADR 0278 § 1's roster, `TRUE`/`FALSE` in § 8's table). Readers beside the others in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:160`.

backlog: The rule fragment `docs/rules/core-classes/ldap-value-types` says "one `bool` per flag"; ADR 0278 § 8 writes `AccountFlags::$mustChangePassword` as a property. Readers are methods; say so in the fragment when `with` lands.
Stage 7 writes: a flag object is written back with `bits()`, so `modify` encodes it as that integer (ADR 0278 § 8).
The flag classes' feature proofs (`bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags'`) are Stage 10's.
